scope: Study-specific end-to-end localization/transcription against released XML; not the paper's query-by-string/example retrieval mAP task or an official leaderboard reproduction

primary_reference.source: Original object/name and bndbox in released native test XML
primary_reference.normalization: Reuse pinned scorer: Unicode NFKC, casefold, split/join whitespace; preserve digits, punctuation, diacritics, one-character labels and literal *
primary_reference.xml_crop_disagreements: Use XML text, never crop-index slash-to-hyphen rewrites; ambiguous equivalent crop assignments do not replace XML object identity
primary_reference.granularity: one released XML object, original ordinal; no GT splitting/merging

eligibility.pool: All 1,755 native test PNG/XML pairs in the pinned release
eligibility.keep: Decoded PNG and parsed paired XML; every box satisfies 0 <= xmin < xmax <= PNG width and 0 <= ymin < ymax <= PNG height; every normalized transcription nonblank; difficult flag exactly 0
eligibility.metadata_only_repair: Use decoded PNG width/height for derived evaluation metadata; preserve raw XML, all coordinates and text; no scaling, clipping or extrapolation
eligibility.integrity_failure: Unexpected source hashes/counts or EDA discrepancy hard-stop freeze; never silently reduce the expected denominator
eligibility.hold_rationale: Whole-frame exclusion prevents silently converting an invalid labelled region into an unlabelled region while retaining other predictions; no validated ignore mask exists

selective_annotation.known_scope: Paper describes words and excludes equations/symbols; EDA observes inconsistent inclusion of math, logos and interface text; exhaustive word coverage unverified
selective_annotation.prediction_accounting: Every prediction counted; every unmatched prediction FP for released-label detection/spotting, even if it may represent real unannotated text
selective_annotation.ignore_regions: None inferred; no region/category filtering based on GT, semantic review or candidate output
selective_annotation.input_restriction: Models receive full PNG pixels only; GT boxes/text, review flags, dataset lexicon/vocab and sensitivity membership cannot filter, guide or decode predictions
selective_annotation.estimand: Agreement with released annotated instances under fixed matching, normalization and granularity
selective_annotation.recall_interpretation: Recall of annotated instances; not all visible text
selective_annotation.precision_interpretation: Precision relative to released annotations; not certified visible-text precision
selective_annotation.ranking_limit: Different annotation coverage or detection of real unlabelled text can affect ranking; detection diagnostics do not remove that bias

semantic_flag_sensitivity.name: observed_flag_frame_influence
semantic_flag_sensitivity.rule: Exclude entire geometry-eligible test frames containing any uncertain or apparent_disagreement object in the already completed 72-object EDA sample; freeze IDs before spotting outcomes
semantic_flag_sensitivity.scoring: First validate/score full primary prediction set; aggregate retained whole-frame rows, without modifying predictions or GT; retain failures in remaining frames
semantic_flag_sensitivity.reporting: Always publish alongside primary with exact changed denominator and candidate differences; never select whichever endpoint favors a candidate
semantic_flag_sensitivity.limits: Diagnostic influence of known reviewed frames only, not corrected GT, a label-noise bound, a random estimate or proof remaining labels are clean; three frames carry 40 GT objects, only four sampled objects are flagged

post_freeze_changes.new_flags: Log separately with date and identities; no primary denominator or label changes; new analyses explicitly exploratory
post_freeze_changes.corrected_gt: Requires separate independent human/author adjudication, documented annotation scope and missing-region assessment, revision history and a new GT/cohort/protocol version; never overwrite this freeze
post_freeze_changes.test_tuning: No test-score-based model/config/threshold/grouping/GT/cohort changes; version and disclose any later exploratory work
post_freeze_changes.external_registration: Local outcome-predeclared freeze after EDA exposure; not externally registered or a blind preregistration

claim_limits: descriptive course-held-out released-image annotation agreement only
test images and references exposed during EDA; no untouched/blind test claim
no human-gold correctness, exhaustive OCR/annotation recall or production winner claim
course IDs and folder groups are proxies; video identity and universal writer independence not authenticated
dHash review closes its 469-pair queue only; transformed-content screening recall unknown
historical model-use completeness and pretraining overlap unknown
seven course clusters give exploratory conditional uncertainty, not population generalization or statistical-power proof
candidate runtime-loading verification is a separate inference gate

scientific_sources.supports: Section III word annotation seeded by TextSpotter and edited in LabelImg, equations/symbols excluded, course partition; Section V-B IoU > 0.5. Does not certify present XML correctness or our Hmean endpoint
ICDAR2015 localization plus transcription evaluation background; our matching/normalization/ignore policy remains explicitly study-specific

Northcutt et al. 2021: test-label errors can alter benchmark comparisons; motivates transparent raw-label primary and bounded influence diagnostic, not automated correction or a CVID error-rate estimate
Nosek et al. 2018: distinguish analysis choices declared before outcomes from post-hoc exploration; this local freeze is not an external registration
